scope: safe additive expansion of cosmology, evidence, tooling, and governance

source_basis.directional_material: AlphaXiv e RLL/rLLM: arquitetura, estado interno documentado, expansão segura e governança
source_basis.adaptation_rule: external framework specifics are not imported as RLL internals; only transferable governance invariants are adopted

gates.purpose: pin repository, branch, commit, schema/source identity
one bounded delta per promotion unit
preserve and compare against an observed predecessor
validate types, units, ranges, dependencies, and invariants before execution
prove that a configured mechanism is actually implemented/effective in the selected execution path
prefer inspection/preflight before mutation or claim-bearing execution
exercise a bounded successor before full-scale execution
edge-case, adversarial, numerical, and non-regression tests
increase data/compute/concurrency only after prior gate evidence
receipt, rollback pointer, deterministic output separation, and fail-closed claim state

invariants: SOURCE != CONFIG != ARTEFACT != EXECUTION != EVIDENCE != CLAIM
